title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description: Cloud infrastructure: build a VPC that is actually private, then everything that runs inside it — and know what each piece costs.
descriptionAr: بنية تحتية سحابية: ابنِ VPC خاصة فعلًا، ثم كل ما يعمل بداخلها — واعرف تكلفة كل جزء.

productionProject.title: An AWS account you can defend in review
productionProject.titleAr: حساب AWS يمكنك الدفاع عنه في المراجعة
productionProject.summary: 81 resources from four Terraform modules: a VPC across two availability zones with flow logs and NACLs, EKS with IRSA and KMS envelope encryption, ECR with immutable tags and a lifecycle policy, and a build host with IMDSv2 enforced and no static keys anywhere.

contentGaps: AWS global infrastructure, regions, availability zones and the Shared Responsibility Model
CloudWatch, CloudTrail and Cost Explorer as a single operations chapter
Route 53, DNS and VPC connectivity (endpoints, peering)
KMS and encryption across S3, EBS and RDS
EBS and EFS as their own chapter alongside S3
